about: Signing out, and a change of person. Every answer names the stamp of the shell it stands in; when that differs from the stamp of the shell held, the shell is fetched again. When it then says nobody is signed in, what the screens showed and everything kept is thrown away. When someone else signs in, nothing of the person before stays, not even where they were. A client that ends the session itself says so, and everything goes.

steps.note: This app keeps pages between launches, so it first reads what it kept.

steps.note: The shell arrives, with its stamp in a header of its answer. It is handed to the client to keep.

steps.note: The page names the same stamp: the shell held is the one it stands in.
The person chooses Sign out in the user menu, which belongs to no screen: it runs on the screen in front.

steps.note: The server signs them out and redirects to the sign-in.

steps.note: The sign-in is a cover, and its answer names another shell stamp. Something was written, so the pages kept are thrown away; the stamp differs from the shell's, so the shell is asked for again.

steps.note: The shell says nobody is signed in. The screen underneath is emptied, though it keeps its address, and everything kept is thrown away.

headers: platform=android; form=phone; vocab=0; scheme=light; contrast=normal; text=1.00

steps.note: Somebody signs in. The cover goes, the shell is asked for, and the screen underneath is fetched.

platform=android; form=phone; vocab=0; scheme=light; contrast=normal; text=1.00

steps.note: It is another person. Nothing of the one before stays: the screens go, their requests are no longer wanted, and the first destination starts afresh.

headers: platform=android; form=phone; vocab=0; scheme=light; contrast=normal; text=1.00

steps.note: Here the stamp is in the envelope itself, where a server may also write it. It is the new shell's: nothing more is asked.
The client ended the session itself (the person signed out in a web view, say) and threw its cookies away. Everything goes, and the app starts again.
